mcqs.question: The University of London, associated with the proposed Birkbeck campus in Bengaluru, was established under which landmark instrument?
options: UGC Regulations on Foreign Higher Educational Institutions
mcqs.explanation: The University of London was established under a Royal Charter in 1836 and functions as a federation of institutions. The UGC Act, National Education Policy and UGC Regulations are separate Indian higher-education instruments, not the founding instrument of the University of London.
